title: Interlock release signals and rollback matrix for shared API/Console/Runtime train
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define a lightweight, operational release signal matrix and a graduated rollback/cutline matrix for the combined API / Console / Runtime release train. Goal: remove ambiguity when deciding scope locks, conditional rollouts, and emergency cut criteria across teams. Deliverables: (1) signal matrix (what metrics/alerts map to green/amber/red per component), (2) agreed cut tiers and exception workflow, (3) decision roles and on-call escalation steps, (4) a public release summary template for release notes and GTM teams.
acceptance_criteria: Signal matrix doc (Confluence) accepted by ENG, SRE, and DX leads
Cut-tier table with thresholds and owners published and linked in release checklist
Rollback matrix that covers partial fallback (model variant routing), regional cutover, and full rollback with runbooks
Template for release notes that includes cut signals and known mitigations is approved by GTM and PM
At least one cross-team tabletop drill scheduled before scope lock to validate decisions
checklist: Draft initial signal matrix (api latency, request errors, console render errors, runtime token error rates)
Review thresholds with SRE and runtime infra (determine noise floor and burn-rate tolerances)
Define cut tiers (Tier 0: immediate rollback, Tier 1: canary pause, Tier 2: monitor) and acceptance thresholds
Assign decision owners and escalation path for each tier
Document exception approval flow for post-freeze scope changes
Create release-notes template and notify GTM owners
Schedule cross-team tabletop exercise (eng, sse, product, dx, support)
Publish final artifacts in Confluence and link from release checklist
updates: 2026-03-02: Ticket created after weekly release-planning sync. Noted recurring ambiguity in ‘scope lock’ emails between Console and Runtime teams.
2026-03-04: Initial draft of signal matrix uploaded to Confluence (see link). SRE suggested moving API 95th p95 to p99 for spike sensitivity.
2026-03-05: DX review: console render error taxonomy updated to separate third-party asset failures from core console errors.
2026-03-07: Trade-off call with Runtime: proposed Tier 1 pause should prefer model-variant fallback instead of full rollback to avoid customer regressions. Action: add model routing fallback section.

2026-03-09: PM sync: GTM requested release-notes template include upgrade impact notes for Dedicated customers and Private deployment instructions. Added to checklist. Tabletop exercise proposed for 2026-03-28.
